age.evidence: Males of 8–10 weeks of age underwent viral injection surgeries, followed by implantation of ... GRIN lens at 10–12 weeks, and behavior at 12–16 weeks

sex.evidence: Only males were used in the imaging experiment due to lower throughput nature of the technique

dosing.evidence: Mice were administered psilocybin (1.0 mg kg−1, i.p., n = 15) or saline (n = 10) 30 min before Extinction 1.

handling.evidence: Paper does not describe a deliberate handling habituation protocol beyond miniscope habituation.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were singly housed following implant surgery.

day_night_flipped.evidence: Mice were kept on a reverse 12-h light/12-h dark cycle. Behavior was performed at least 1 h and no more than 4 h following lights-off.

enrichment_housing.evidence: Paper describes housing conditions but does not mention home-cage enrichment.

assays.assay_description: 5-day TFC paradigm (Habituation, Acquisition, Extinction 1–3) in Med Associates fear conditioning chambers. CS = 4 kHz, 75 dB tone (25 s); 20 s trace; 1–2 mA, 2 s shock on Acquisition only. Freezing scored as % time immobile via ezTrack. Psilocybin given 30 min before Extinction 1.

setup_habituation.evidence: One week before behavioral testing, GRIN lens-implanted mice were habituated to the Miniscope for 2 days in 10-min sessions in the home cage. Day 1 of the paradigm is also a Habituation session in context A.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice moved freely in Med Associates fear conditioning chambers; only a miniscope was attached.

food_restriction.evidence: Standard fear conditioning chambers; no food in apparatus during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: Standard fear conditioning chambers; no water in apparatus during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were injected 30 min before Extinction 1; behavior was also recorded on Extinction 2 (~24 h post) and Extinction 3 (~48 h post).

sample_size.evidence: psilocybin (n = 15) or saline (n = 10); low-freezing saline n=4, high-freezing saline n=6, low-freezing psilocybin n=7, high-freezing psilocybin n=8

outcomes.summary: On average, psilocybin had no effect on extinction, but freezing was highly skewed. A GMM-defined low-freezing psilocybin subgroup froze significantly less than low-freezing saline mice during the trace period of early Extinction 3. Acutely (Extinction 1), psilocybin increased bout number and decreased bout length, indicating disrupted sustained freezing.
outcomes.statistics: Extinction 1: F(treatment)(1,21)=35.93, P=0.0087 (bouts); Extinction 3: F(interaction)(1,21)=5.99, P=0.0233; F(group)(3,21)=20.53, P<0.0001 (two-way RM ANOVA with Sidak correction).
outcomes.evidence: Low-freezing psilocybin mice froze significantly less than low-freezing saline mice in Extinction 3, particularly during the trace period of early Extinction 3.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Percent freezing, freezing bouts per minute, median bout length, transitions between freezing/motion, and d' discriminability were reported.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Average freezing was assessed ... in the first three trials (early) and last three trials (late) of the session.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Transitions from freezing to motion and vice versa were robustly encoded ... d' was calculated between motion and freezing.

B4_ethological.evidence: Conditioned freezing is not an ethological behaviour per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: Mice tested individually in fear conditioning boxes.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Trace fear conditioning is a model of complex fear learning ... requiring protracted attention to associate temporally distant stimuli.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Freezing scored by ezTrack pixel-change thresholding (position-tracking style), not a behavioural classifier.

B8_multivariate.evidence: GMM classification of mice and PCA of neural/behavioural trajectories used; linear regression of distance in PC space against freezing.

E2_shelter.evidence: Standard fear conditioning chamber; no enclosed refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: In context B, the shock grid floor was exposed, mouse bedding was placed in a tray under the floor.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in the apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in the apparatus.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water inside the chamber during testing.

D1_continuity.evidence: 5 days of behavioral testing consisted of Habituation, Acquisition, and Extinction 1–3.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Habituation and Acquisition: 8 trials with 60±10 s ITIs; Extinctions: 6 trials. With ~60 s/trial plus ITI and baseline, sessions span ~15–20 min.

D3_recording_days.evidence: 5 days of recording for this assay (Hab, Acq, Ext1–3).

D4_baseline.evidence: Average freezing was assessed at baseline (first 2 min of session); Habituation session recorded pre-drug.

D5_followup.evidence: Extinction 2 (~24 h) and Extinction 3 (~48 h) recorded after psilocybin administration.

assays.assay_description: Mice placed in a sealed, soundproof, dark open-field arena. Recorded under infrared for ~60 min total: 15 min pre-injection baseline, then 1 mg/kg psilocybin i.p., then ~45 min post-injection. Behaviors (stillness, walking, rearing, grooming, licking) scored using DeepLabCut + A-SOiD/B-SOiD.

application_type.evidence: Mice were injected with 1 mg kg−1 psilocybin 15 min after session start.

setup_habituation.evidence: No habituation to the open-field arena described.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice moved freely in the open-field arena.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the open-field arena during recording.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the open-field arena during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were injected 15 min into the session and recorded for another 45 min; recording continued immediately post-injection.

sample_size.evidence: N = 3 GRIN lens-implanted mice were placed in dark open-field arenas.

outcomes.summary: Acute 1 mg/kg psilocybin did not significantly alter immobility bouts, total time immobile, or single-cell/population discriminability of motion vs. immobility in the open field, although median bout length decreased modestly.
outcomes.statistics: Immobility bouts: p=0.5515; median bout length: p=0.0459; total time immobile: p=0.1081; single-cell d': p=0.8208; population PC distance: p=0.2882 (paired t tests).
outcomes.evidence: Acute effects of 1 mg kg−1 psilocybin on locomotion encoding were not observed in open-field controls.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Immobility bouts/min, median bout length, total time immobile, PC-space distance, single-cell d'; behavioral classes (stillness, walking, rearing, grooming, licking).

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Pre- vs post-injection blocks compared (between-period); no within-session time-binned dynamics analyzed.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Trajectories between immobility-on and immobility-off were analyzed in PC space.

B4_ethological.evidence: Behavior was scored ... which scores stillness, walking, rearing, grooming, licking left hindpaw and licking right hindpaw.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Open-field locomotion does not require learning or memory.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Behavior was scored using a DeepLabCut-powered algorithm paired with supervised A-SOiD and unsupervised B-SOiD behavior segmentation algorithms.

B8_multivariate.evidence: PCA-based population analysis and d' discriminability applied to neural/behavioural data.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the arena.

D1_continuity.evidence: One continuous recording bout per mouse.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Mice were recorded for ~60 min total (15 min pre- + 45 min post-injection).

D4_baseline.evidence: Minutes 2–15 pre-injection were analyzed for within-subject comparisons.

D5_followup.evidence: No ≥24 h post-injection recording in this assay.

judge_notes: Sex consolidated to 'male': although a pilot non-imaged behavior-only experiment used both sexes, the methods state that pilot was cut in the final revision and only males were used in the imaging experiment (n=25 = 15 psilo + 10 saline). gptoss inherited the cut pilot from the reporting summary.
B7 for TFC scored 0 (ezTrack is a pixel-change/position tracker, not a behavioural classifier). The DeepLabCut+A-SOiD/B-SOiD pipeline was used only for the open-field assay, where B7=1.
E3 (bedding) for TFC scored 1 based on the explicit mention of bedding in context B under the shock grid floor (acquisition context); bedding is physically present in the apparatus during recording.
time_to_assay for TFC set to 'multiple' because the same assay is recorded acutely (30 min post) and at 24 h (Ext2) and 48 h (Ext3) post-dose.

B2 for OFT scored 0: candidates split, but pre- vs post-injection is a between-period comparison rather than within-session minute-by-minute dynamics; B3 retained as Yes because PC-space trajectories around immobility transitions were analyzed.
Excluded all neural/calcium imaging and TCA components as scorable assays per rubric (neural recording, not behaviour).
